{
  "path": ".github/workflows/ci.yml",
  "size": 1288,
  "content": "name: ci
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -e ".[dev]"
      - run: ruff check .
      - run: ruff format --check .
      - run: pytest -q

  # End-to-end smoke test on real data: one filing, real ONNX embedder, BM25+dense+filters.
  smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: pip
      - run: pip install -e ".[dev]"
      - name: fetch embedder
        run: |
          mkdir -p models
          curl -fsSL -o /tmp/m.tgz https://chroma-onnx-models.s3.amazonaws.com/all-MiniLM-L6-v2/onnx.tar.gz
          echo "913d7300ceae3b2dbc2c50d1de4baacab4be7b9380491c27fab7418616a16ec3  /tmp/m.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf /tmp/m.tgz -C models && mv models/onnx models/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
      - run: python scripts/smoke.py

  docker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: docker compose build api
      - run: docker compose config -q
",
  "truncated": false
}

tools.name: pypi_package
tools.description: PyPI metadata for a package's LATEST release: latest_version, license, requires_python, first_release_date (earliest upload ever), latest_upload_date, release_count (all non-yanked releases), and runtime dependencies (extras excluded). Use this for any question about the latest version, the first release, or the total number of releases.

tools.name: pypi_releases
tools.description: Release history of a PyPI package. total_releases and releases_per_year count every non-yanked release (pre-releases included, dated by first upload). releases_newest_first is a truncated list (see limit), so do not count it to get totals; use total_releases or releases_per_year. Pass year to list one calendar year.

tools.name: pypi_version
tools.description: Metadata for one SPECIFIC version that the question names (requires_python, dependencies, upload date). Do not guess version numbers; for the latest release use pypi_package.

tools.name: github_repo
tools.description: GitHub repository metadata for owner/repo, with description, primary language, license, created and pushed dates, and stars.

tools.name: github_languages
tools.description: Every language GitHub detects in a repository, with bytes and percent. The number of languages is the number of keys.

tools.name: github_list_dir
tools.description: List files and folders at a path in a GitHub repository (default branch). Empty path means the root.

tools.name: github_read_file
tools.description: Read a text file (for example pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, go.mod, .github/workflows/ci.yml) from a GitHub repository's default branch, truncated to max_chars.

tools.name: github_workflow_runs
tools.description: Recent GitHub Actions runs (newest first) with workflow name, event, conclusion and branch.

tools.name: github_commits
tools.description: Recent commits on the default branch (newest first), with short sha, date and first line of message.

tools.name: github_create_pull_request
tools.description: Open a DRAFT pull request that writes the given files on a new branch. Requires a human approval bound to this exact payload; without one it returns the approval command to run.
